CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY)
1. Learned HCGP on instructions submits that, after investigation, the police have filed 'B' final report in the present case.
2. The said submission is placed on record.
3. In view of the said submission, the prayer made in this petition does not survive for consideration.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed.
